bibliographic.title: Integrating Stock Features and Global Information via Large Language Models for Enhanced Stock Return Prediction
bibliographic.authors: Ding, Y.; Jia, S.; Ma, T.; Mao, B.; Zhou, X.; Li, L.; Han, D.

classification.decision_basis: Presents an LLM-augmented return prediction framework (Local-Global model + SCRL/PPO alignment) with a daily long-only backtest; no tool-calling/closed-loop agent trading workflow is described.

architecture.model_stack: Local-Global (LG) model + Self-Correlated Reinforcement Learning (SCRL) with PPO (Actor/Critic). LLM: Llama (7B), continued training for 2 epochs on ~15GB Chinese corpus (CLUECorpusSmall + Chinese Scientific Literature Dataset); Chinese tokenizer (Cui et al., 2023) with vocab expanded to 49,953; Llama LR 2e-5 with cosine decay; trained/fine-tuned on 8x Nvidia A100 80GB. PPO settings include 2,048 steps, LR 0.00025, batch size 128, reward scaling 1e-4. F(·) uses a 2-layer MLP [324,36,1] with ReLU.
architecture.environment: Backtest with daily sorting into 10 quantiles; hold an equal-weight portfolio of the top 10% quantile and liquidate others; transactions at close with 0.3% transaction cost; backtest period 01/01/2022–12/31/2022; restricts news to 15:30 previous trading day to 09:30 current trading day.

market_setting.universe: China A-shares; 3,506 stocks; excludes suspended stocks and stocks listed after 2020
market_setting.horizon: Forecast horizons: 5/10/20 trading days ahead; reports top-quantile 1-day holding performance
market_setting.data_sources: Daily features (342) built from stock price-volume data; collected news headlines (162,845) over the same period
market_setting.market_constraints: Transactions at close; transaction cost 0.3%; uses only news released 15:30 (prev day) to 09:30 (current day); excludes suspended/late-listed stocks

evaluation.tier_justification: Uses an explicit out-of-sample backtest (01/01/2022–12/31/2022) with transaction costs (0.3%) and compares multiple baselines/variants. Missing microstructure realism (slippage/impact/fill model) and broader robustness details keeps it below Tier 3.
evaluation.key_metrics: Table 1 (mean ± std): SCRL-LG RankIC 0.152 ± 0.003; Annual Return 0.288 ± 0.05; Top Minus Bottom 1.83 ± 0.11; Sharpe Ratio 1.24 ± 0.15; MDD 0.219 ± 0.02. Also reports cumulative returns, turnover rates, and horizon-dependent annual return/Sharpe/turnover.
evaluation.baselines: Local (w/o Global model), LG-STOCK (w/o LLM in Global model), LG-LLM (w/o stock features in Global model)
evaluation.ablations: Global information variants: stock-only (LG-STOCK), LLM-only (LG-LLM), and combined with SCRL alignment (SCRL-LG) vs Local-only
evaluation.robustness_tests: Evaluates prediction horizons (5/10/20 trading days ahead) and discusses the impact of transaction costs; reports standard deviations in Table 1

realism.note: Includes transaction cost (0.3%) and close-price execution; no explicit slippage/impact or liquidity constraints.

temporal_validity.note: Time split (train 2019–2021; test/backtest 2022) and a news-time window are specified; leakage/survivorship controls are not fully documented.

tuning_hygiene.note: Hyperparameters are listed, but no clear nested tuning/walk-forward model selection protocol is described.

baseline_strength.note: Compares to internal variants (Local/LG-STOCK/LG-LLM) but lacks strong external non-LLM baselines in the reported results snippet.

statistical_validity.note: Reports mean ± standard deviation (Table 1); no formal significance testing or repeated backtest procedure details are provided.

execution_feasibility.note: Daily close execution is feasible for the stated frequency; fill dynamics and trading constraints are simplified.

data_provenance.note: Dataset composition and counts are described (stocks/features/news), but dataset name/provenance and reproducibility details are unclear.

ablation_completeness.note: Ablates global-information sources (stock-only vs LLM-only vs combined) but does not fully isolate all SCRL/PPO components.

transparency.note: Provides many training details (LLM continued training, PPO settings, MLP shape) but omits full data release and some evaluation protocol specifics.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe um framework para prever retornos no mercado A-share que separa retorno idiossincrático (features de volume/preco) e informacao global (news/macro/industria) via um modelo Local-Global. Introduz o SCRL (PPO Actor-Critic) para alinhar embeddings de noticias geradas por Llama com features quantitativas no mesmo espaco semantico, melhorando RankIC e retorno em backtest.
pontos_fortes: Backtest fora da amostra (2022) com custo de transacao (0.3%) e regras claras de execucao (close) e janela de noticias.
Ablacao interna coerente (Local vs LG-STOCK vs LG-LLM vs SCRL-LG) com metricas financeiras e desvio padrao reportados.
pontos_fracos: Nao e um sistema de trading agentico; e um modelo preditivo (sem ferramentas, governanca, ou loop de decisao/excecucao em ambiente real).
Microestrutura simplificada (sem slippage/impacto/liquidez) e detalhes incompletos de higiene de tuning/robustez.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: modelo preditivo de retornos que combina features diarias de preco-volume com informacao global extraida de noticias via Llama, usando um decompositor Local-Global e alinhamento via SCRL (PPO).
2) Evidencia: Tier 2, pois ha backtest out-of-sample em 01/01/2022–12/31/2022 com custo de transacao (0.3%) e comparacao de baselines internos.
3) Limitacao principal: execucao e microestrutura sao simplificadas (close + custo fixo), e nao ha validacao live-like nem controles completos de tuning/leakage.
4) Falha provavel: degradacao em regimes com friccoes/impacto maiores ou quando a coleta/rotulagem de news nao replica o tempo real.
5) Taxonomia: N (non-agentic) no survey de agentic trading, mas relevante como bloco de 'signal generation' LLM+features.
6) Uso no survey: exemplo de alinhamento multimodal (news embeddings -> features) e teste de horizontes 5/10/20 dias.

bibliographic.title: Complex forecasting and investment strategy optimization via chain-of-thought of large language models
bibliographic.authors: Yin, M.; Guo, M.

classification.decision_basis: Uses chain-of-thought prompting with ChatGPT 4.0 for earnings-direction forecasting and portfolio optimization/backtesting; no tool-calling or closed-loop agentic trading workflow is described.

architecture.model_stack: ChatGPT 4.0 with chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting applied to numerical financial statements; no fine-tuning/RAG/memory/tools described in the excerpted text.
architecture.environment: Backtests of an investment strategy derived from LLM forecasts on Chinese A-share listed companies (2010–2023).

market_setting.horizon: Earnings direction prediction (exact forecast horizon not specified in excerpt); strategy backtested over 2010–2023 data

data_provenance.note: Data source described as anonymized financial statements from 608 A-share companies; reproducibility and release details are unclear.

ablation_completeness.note: No component ablations described in excerpt.

transparency.note: High-level methodology and headline metrics are stated; full prompts/protocol details are not present in excerpt.

synthesis.contribuicao: Aplica chain-of-thought (CoT) em um LLM (ChatGPT 4.0) para raciocinio numerico em demonstracoes financeiras e previsao de direcao de earnings, conectando isso a uma etapa de otimizacao de portfolio. Reporta ganhos de acuracia vs analistas humanos e melhora de performance em backtest (alpha/Sharpe) no universo de A-shares.
pontos_fortes: Conecta explicitamente previsao (earnings direction) a uma decisao de investimento (portfolio) e reporta metricas financeiras (alpha/Sharpe/beta).
Benchmark direto vs analistas humanos (64.35% vs 58.37%).
pontos_fracos: Detalhes criticos de realismo e validade temporal (custos, slippage, splits/leakage) nao estao claros no trecho disponivel.
Nao e um sistema agentico (sem tool-calls, governanca, ou loop de execucao/monitoramento).
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: CoT + ChatGPT 4.0 para previsao de direcao de earnings usando apenas dados numericos; sinal alimenta uma etapa de otimizacao de portfolio.
2) Evidencia: Tier 1 (backtest reportado, mas faltam detalhes de friccoes/validacao).
3) Limitacao: protocolo completo e controles de leakage/custos nao estao totalmente especificados no trecho.
4) Falha provavel: degradacao quando friccoes e restricoes reais dominam, ou quando o split temporal nao for rigoroso.
5) Taxonomia: N (non-agentic), relevante como exemplo de 'LLM reasoning' aplicado a signal+portfolio.
6) Uso no survey: mostra CoT para dados numericos e como isso pode virar uma estrategia/portfolio.

bibliographic.title: ChronosRL: embeddings-based reinforcement learning agent for financial trading
bibliographic.authors: Lima, A. M. A.; Oliveira, A. L.; Zanchettin, C.

classification.decision_basis: Reinforcement-learning trading agents using transformer embeddings (Chronos) for crypto trading; no LLM tool-calling workflow or agentic trading loop is described.

architecture.model_stack: Chronos transformer embeddings used as input representations for deep reinforcement learning (ChronosRL). Operates in a zero-shot setting (no fine-tuning of the transformer) per abstract.
architecture.environment: Backtesting in Freqtrade (and mentions FreqAI and MLflow) for cryptocurrency trading; compares RL agents vs rule-based baselines.

market_setting.universe: Six crypto pairs: BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT, XRP/USDT, ADA/USDT, AVAX/USDT
market_setting.horizon: Five months of data (exact dates not specified in excerpt)
market_setting.sample_period: Five-month experimental window (not dated in excerpt)
market_setting.data_sources: Price time series used for Chronos tokenization/embeddings; benchmark strategies use close/high and technical indicators (EMA, Bollinger Bands)

evaluation.key_metrics: Abstract: mean profit 102% with 79% standard deviation across six crypto pairs over five months. Evaluation metrics section includes Profit, Sharpe Ratio, WinRate, Final Balance, and Number of Trades.
evaluation.baselines: Buy and Hold (BH), Random Agent (RA), Double Moving Average (DMA), Moving Average with Bollinger Bands (MABB); also references a technical-analysis RL baseline (TARL) in results discussion.
evaluation.ablations: Compares Chronos-based representation (CH agent) vs traditional technical-analysis inputs/baselines; evaluates performance by currency pair.
evaluation.robustness_tests: Reports mean and standard deviation across experimental trials; evaluates across multiple crypto pairs.

realism.note: Uses a trading-bot backtesting framework (Freqtrade) and reports multiple trading metrics; explicit fees/slippage are not stated in excerpt.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe o ChronosRL, um framework de trading em cripto que usa embeddings gerados por um transformer pre-treinado (Chronos) como representacao de estado para agentes de deep RL. O foco e demonstrar que representacoes aprendidas (zero-shot) superam features tecnicas manuais em ambientes volateis, com avaliacao em seis pares USDT.
pontos_fortes: Benchmarking amplo com baselines simples (Buy&Hold, regras EMA/BB, random) e metricas de trading (Profit/Sharpe/WinRate).
Avalia generalizacao em multiplos pares e reporta variabilidade (media e desvio padrao).

Nao e um sistema agentico baseado em LLM com tool-calls; e um agente de RL com embeddings.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: embeddings do Chronos alimentam um agente de deep RL para decidir entradas/saidas em cripto; compara contra baselines tecnicos e Buy&Hold.
2) Evidencia: Tier 1 (backtest offline com metricas, mas friccoes e controles completos nao estao claros no trecho).
3) Limitacao principal: microestrutura/custos e protocolo temporal detalhado nao aparecem no trecho.
4) Falha provavel: sensibilidade a fees/slippage e a mudancas de regime fora do periodo de cinco meses.
5) Taxonomia: N (non-agentic) no survey de agentic trading, mas relevante como 'execution/decision policy' baseada em representacoes foundation.
6) Uso no survey: exemplo de como modelos foundation de series temporais podem substituir engenharia de features em DRL.

bibliographic.title: Decision-informed Neural Networks with Large Language Model Integration for Portfolio Optimization
bibliographic.authors: Hwang, Y.; Kong, Y.; Zohren, S.; Lee, Y.

classification.decision_basis: Decision-focused portfolio optimization using a pretrained LLM encoder (GPT-2) and a differentiable convex optimization layer; not an agentic tool-calling trading system.

architecture.model_stack: DINN: cross-attention integrates market- and stock-level embeddings; frozen pretrained LLM g_phi used as contextual encoder (GPT-2 chosen to mitigate leakage concerns); additive fusion; linear projection to multi-horizon return forecasts; differentiable convex mean-variance optimization layer producing portfolio weights; risk-aversion parameter lambda selected from a candidate set.
architecture.environment: Offline backtest / out-of-sample portfolio evaluation using equity index constituents plus macro indicators; optimization solved per time step via convex programming layer.

market_setting.universe: DOW 30 and a market-cap-weighted subset of 50 constituents from the S&P 100 (companies with consistent index membership to address survivorship bias)
market_setting.horizon: Predicts normalized returns over horizon H (multi-horizon forecasts); uses a lookback window and past three months of historical returns for covariance estimation
market_setting.sample_period: January 2010–December 2023
market_setting.data_sources: Equity returns from WRDS; five macroeconomic indicators from FRED (ICSA, UMCSENT, HSN1F, unemployment rate, CPI per text excerpt)
market_setting.market_constraints: Mean-variance objective with convex risk constraints; risk-aversion parameter lambda (e.g., balanced profile lambda=0.9545) and portfolio weight optimization via convex layer

evaluation.tier_justification: Reports an out-of-sample portfolio evaluation with extensive metrics (Ret/Std/Sharpe/Sortino/MDD/VaR/Wealth), macro-regime analyses, and comparisons to multiple deep-learning baselines; still lacks explicit market microstructure/friction modeling in the excerpt.
evaluation.key_metrics: Reports portfolio metrics including Annualised Return, Std, Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, MDD, monthly 95% VaR, Return over VaR, and terminal Wealth; also reports mean ± standard deviation across experimental trials (e.g., Table A.1) and gradient-based analyses by macro regimes (COVID/ICSA/HSN1/UMCS/ALL).
evaluation.baselines: Compares DINN against transformer-based and LLM-based time series models (explicit baseline list referenced in 'Baseline Models and Hyperparameter Selection' section; names not fully visible in excerpt).
evaluation.ablations: Varies risk-aversion parameter lambda over {0.0145, 0.2656, 0.9545, 2.4305, 3.4623} and reports performance for each profile; includes gradient-based sensitivity analyses for decision-focused behavior.
evaluation.robustness_tests: Macro-regime analyses (e.g., COVID-19, ICSA, HSN1, UMCSENT) and reporting of mean ± standard deviation across multiple training runs/random seeds.

realism.note: Uses portfolio optimization layer and risk metrics (VaR/MDD) with out-of-sample evaluation; explicit transaction costs/slippage are not described in excerpt.

temporal_validity.note: Covers 2010–2023 and explicitly addresses survivorship bias by restricting to consistent index members; discusses LLM leakage risk and mitigates by using GPT-2.

tuning_hygiene.note: Selects lambda from a candidate set and reports results across profiles; full nested validation protocol not fully specified in excerpt.

baseline_strength.note: Describes comparisons against multiple state-of-the-art deep learning architectures including transformer and LLM-based forecasting methods.

statistical_validity.note: Reports mean ± standard deviation across experimental trials and random seeds; formal hypothesis testing not described in excerpt.

execution_feasibility.note: Portfolio weights derived from a convex optimization layer per time step; execution and fill mechanics are abstracted.

data_provenance.note: Clearly specifies WRDS equity returns and FRED macro indicators.

ablation_completeness.note: Includes risk-profile sweeps and gradient-based analyses; component-level ablations of all representation modules are not fully specified in excerpt.

transparency.note: Provides methodological details (GPT-2 choice, optimization layer, metrics, macro regimes) but full implementation/config release is not shown in excerpt.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe um modelo end-to-end (DINN) que integra um LLM pre-treinado (GPT-2 congelado) como encoder contextual e acopla diretamente a previsao de retornos a uma camada de otimizacao convexa diferenciavel (mean-variance). A tese central e reduzir o 'prediction-decision gap' ao treinar representacoes e previsao com objetivo alinhado a performance de portfolio, avaliado em DOW30 e S&P100 com macro-variaveis do FRED.
pontos_fortes: Integra previsao e decisao via camada de otimizacao diferenciavel, com avaliacao extensa de metricas (Sharpe/Sortino/MDD/VaR/Wealth).
Cuida de validade temporal: periodo longo (2010–2023), tentativa de mitigar survivorship bias e discute risco de leakage de LLM (usa GPT-2).
pontos_fracos: Nao modela explicitamente friccoes de execucao (custos, slippage, impacto) no trecho analisado.
Nao e um sistema agentico de trading (sem tool-calls/monitoramento/governanca operacional); e um modelo de otimizacao/forecast.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: DINN usa atencao + encoder LLM (GPT-2) para gerar previsoes multi-horizonte e converte isso em pesos via otimizacao convexa diferenciavel.
2) Evidencia: Tier 2 (backtest out-of-sample com metricas e baselines, analises por regimes; mas sem microestrutura).
3) Limitacao principal: ausencia de modelagem detalhada de custos/fills e restricoes operacionais.
4) Falha provavel: degradacao quando friccoes e restricoes reais dominam o resultado do portfolio.
5) Taxonomia: N (non-agentic), mas um exemplo forte de 'decision-focused learning' aplicavel ao bloco portfolio do survey.
6) Uso no survey: mostra como usar LLM como encoder contextual + camada de otimizacao para reduzir o prediction-decision gap.

bibliographic.title: FinReasoner: A Lightweight LLM Framework for Financial Forecasting
bibliographic.authors: Guo, W.; Xiang, Y.

classification.decision_basis: LLM-based forecasting framework using chain-of-thought fine-tuning, distillation, and DoRA; produces trading decisions/signals but does not describe a tool-calling, closed-loop agentic trading workflow.

architecture.model_stack: FinReasoner: deep ensemble distillation with two teacher models generating reasoning samples via structured prompts; compact student model fine-tuned with chain-of-thought; DoRA (weight-decomposed low-rank adaptation) used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning; focuses on multi-indicator (e.g., MACD/MA/KDJ/RSI) reasoning.
architecture.environment: Offline evaluation/backtest on SSE 50 index constituents; generates long/short signals with chain-of-thought explanations.

market_setting.universe: SSE 50 index (China) constituents
market_setting.data_sources: Technical indicators for candlestick/time-series forecasting (e.g., MACD, MA, KDJ, RSI)

evaluation.tier_justification: Reports strategy-level performance on SSE 50 (annualized return and maximum drawdown) and discusses ablations, but full backtest protocol, frictions, and leakage controls are not fully specified in the excerpt.
evaluation.key_metrics: SSE 50 results: annualized return 84.26% and maximum drawdown 6.29%. Mentions t-test with p-value 0.054 for an ablation comparison. Discusses inference throughput (33.1 tokens/s) and fine-tuning time for 1,000+ samples over 3 epochs.
evaluation.baselines: State-of-the-art benchmarks (not enumerated in the excerpted header); compares against label-only and summary-augmented variants in ablations.
evaluation.ablations: Ablation studies on structured reasoning chains (FinReasoner vs label-only / summary-augmented variants); reports p-value 0.054 trend.

ablation_completeness.note: Includes ablations around reasoning-chain supervision and variants.

synthesis.contribuicao: Apresenta o FinReasoner, um framework leve de LLM para previsao financeira e tomada de decisao baseada em indicadores tecnicos, combinando distillacao (teachers -> student) com fine-tuning via chain-of-thought e DoRA. O foco e tornar a decisao interpretavel (cadeias de raciocinio) sem depender de um LLM grande em producao, reportando forte retorno anualizado e baixo drawdown no SSE 50.
pontos_fortes: Integra interpretabilidade (CoT) com um pipeline de compressao/afinacao (distillacao + DoRA) pensando em deploy leve.
Reporta metricas de estrategia (84.26% anualizado; 6.29% MDD) e discute ablations com teste estatistico (p=0.054).
pontos_fracos: Detalhes de protocolo (periodo, split temporal, friccoes) nao aparecem claramente no trecho analisado.
Nao e agentic trading (sem ferramentas/loop operacional), e a otimizacao para inferencia real-time e citada como limitacao.
synthesis.advisor_summary:

bibliographic.authors: Lee, Y.; Kim, Y.; Kim, J.; Kim, S.; Lee, Y.

classification.decision_basis: Uses LLMs to generate return views and confidence levels that feed a Black-Litterman portfolio optimizer with backtesting; no tool-calling, closed-loop agentic trading workflow is described.

architecture.model_stack: Structured prompting to elicit LLM return forecasts and uncertainty; transforms forecasts into Black-Litterman investor views and confidence; tunes BL hyperparameter tau on a dedicated validation period; then runs single-period BL and mean-variance optimization with constraints (sum weights=1, no shorting). LLM variants include Gemma/Qwen/Llama/GPT in the reported analysis.
architecture.environment: Backtest on S&P 500 constituents with transaction costs modeled as 0.1% of portfolio weight changes at each rebalancing.

market_setting.horizon: Rebalancing-period return forecasts (exact forecast horizon not specified in excerpt); validation and test spans June 2024–June 2025

market_setting.data_sources: Stock price/return data for lookback + evaluation; LLM prompts include daily returns, sector returns, and market returns (example shows AAPL + sector + market returns)
market_setting.market_constraints: No shorting; weights sum to 1; risk aversion parameter lambda=0.1; transaction costs = 0.1% of weight changes per rebalancing

evaluation.tier_justification: Backtest includes transaction costs and multiple risk/downside metrics (Sharpe, MDD, VaR/CVaR), and uses a dedicated validation period to tune tau before testing on unseen data; microstructure/fill realism beyond this is not evident in excerpt.

evaluation.baselines: Mean-Variance Optimization (MVO) benchmark; compares multiple LLM-driven BL variants (BLM-Gemma/BLM-Qwen/BLM-Llama/BLM-GPT) and analyzes view-statistics by model.
evaluation.ablations: Compares different LLMs as view generators and relates each model's view distribution ('investment style') to portfolio outcomes; reports forecasting-error tables by model.
evaluation.robustness_tests: Uses a separate 3-month validation period for hyperparameter tuning and a 10-month test period; analyzes model 'styles' and their dependence on market regime.

realism.note: Includes transaction costs (0.1% of weight changes) and downside metrics; does not specify slippage/impact/fill models in excerpt.

temporal_validity.note: Explicit validation (Jun–Aug 2024) and test (Sep 2024–Jun 2025) periods; uses unseen data for backtesting.

tuning_hygiene.note: Uses a dedicated validation period to tune tau (and discusses grid search for optimal tau).

Mostra em backtest no S&P 500 (com custo de transacao) que portfolios baseados em LLMs top superam baselines, e que cada LLM expressa um 'estilo de investimento' consistente cujo desempenho depende do regime.

bibliographic.title: EFS: Evolutionary Factor Searching for Sparse Portfolio Optimization Using Large Language Models
bibliographic.authors: Luo, H.; Zhang, Y.; Liu, C. (2025)

classification.decision_basis: Framework uses LLMs to generate/mutate/crossover executable alpha factors, then iteratively backtests and prunes factors based on performance feedback in a rolling loop for sparse portfolio construction.

architecture.model_stack: LLM backend (reported GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek variants) generates factor code via prompt-defined mutation/crossover; no fine-tuning described; uses performance feedback (e.g., Sharpe, RankIC) to guide evolutionary search.

market_setting.horizon: Next-period return ranking (RankIC uses t vs. t+1); daily portfolio returns on real-market datasets
market_setting.data_sources: Kenneth R. French Data Library; daily closing prices for constructed US/HK/China pools (source not specified in excerpt).
market_setting.market_constraints: Long-only and fully-invested weights with an m-sparsity (top-m) constraint; equal-weight or positive-score weighting. Transaction costs/slippage not specified.

evaluation.ablations: Prompt composition ablations (w/o sparse heuristic, numeric metrics, quality indicators, performance feedback) and seed library ablations (w/o TA seed factors; Initial Factor only).
evaluation.robustness_tests: Multiple markets and regimes (explicit bull/bear phase analysis) plus checkpointing/freeze via record ratio and weighting-temperature sweeps.

realism.note: Imposes long-only, budget, and sparsity constraints; no explicit transaction costs/market impact model reported.

temporal_validity.note: Defines next-period targets (t+1) and includes a 'data safety guarantee' limiting LLM inputs to abstract factor definitions and backtest metrics (no tickers/dates).

tuning_hygiene.note: Evolution uses backtest feedback and search hyperparameters; some repeated trials are reported, but full nested selection controls are unclear.

baseline_strength.note: Compares against both classic and recent optimization baselines plus ML selectors.

statistical_validity.note: Reports mean±std over 3 runs in ablations; limited inferential testing.

execution_feasibility.note: Daily close-to-close backtesting for sparse top-m selection; execution/fill realism not modeled.

data_provenance.note: Uses public Kenneth French benchmarks and clearly defined real-market universes/timeframes.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe um loop evolutivo guiado por LLM para gerar e evoluir fatores alfa executáveis (mutacao/crossover) e selecionar fatores com base em feedback de backtest, visando portfolios esparsos (top-m). O foco em esparsidade e interpretabilidade end-to-end diferencia o trabalho de bibliotecas estaticas e de mineracao one-shot.
pontos_fortes: Loop fechado de geracao→backtest→poda, com ablations cobrindo prompt/priors.
Avalia em benchmarks Fama-French e em tres mercados reais com baselines fortes.
pontos_fracos: Nao explicita custos de transacao/slippage/impacto; evidencia e puramente offline.
Risco de sobreajuste por feedback de backtest (data-mining) apesar de repeticoes/controles descritos.

4) Taxonomia: agente de pesquisa/codigo + executor de backtest (planner-executor) para sinal e alocacao em portfolios esparsos.

classification.decision_basis: Agente LLM para trading com modulos de profiling, memoria em camadas (FAISS) e decisao; ingere dados via APIs (Yahoo Finance/yfinance, Alpaca News) e faz backtest diario, mas nao descreve um loop explicito de replanejamento/auto-revisao no momento da decisao.

architecture.model_stack: Framework FINMEM com 3 modulos (Profiling, Memory, Decision-making). Memoria em camadas (shallow/intermediate/deep) com ranking por recency/relevancy/importance; usa FAISS para busca semantica; avalia diferentes backbones (davinci-003, GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-4-Turbo, Llama2-70b-chat).

market_setting.horizon: Decisao/acao diaria (proximo dia) com base em noticias + precos e memoria.
market_setting.data_sources: OHLCV diario via Yahoo Finance (yfinance); noticias via Alpaca News API (backend Benzinga); SEC filings 10-Q (intermediate) e 10-K (deep); memoria em FAISS com embeddings (compatibilidade OpenAI citada).

evaluation.baselines: Buy-and-Hold; LLM agents: GenerativeAgents, FinGPT; DRL: A2C, PPO, DQN (Stable-Baselines3).
evaluation.ablations: Ajuste de Top-K (cognitive span) na memoria; configuracoes de perfil de risco (risk inclinations); comparacao de backbones LLM.
evaluation.robustness_tests: Multiplos tickers (TSLA, NFLX, AMZN, MSFT, COIN) e avaliacao com treino reduzido (menos de 6 meses) vs janela maior.

execution_feasibility.note: Nao descreve modelo de preenchimento, custos, slippage ou restricoes operacionais de execucao.

data_provenance.note: Fontes e tipos de dados sao especificados (yfinance, Alpaca/Benzinga, SEC 10-Q/10-K).

transparency.note: Reporta tabelas de metricas e datas; menciona disponibilidade de codigo (sem detalhes completos no trecho).

synthesis.contribuicao: Apresenta o FINMEM, um agente LLM para decisao em acoes que combina um modulo de profiling (personas/risco), um mecanismo de memoria em camadas alinhado a escalas temporais (news, 10-Q, 10-K) e um modulo de decisao. O sistema usa recuperacao top-K e sumarizacao para priorizar informacao time-sensitive e aumentar interpretabilidade.
pontos_fortes: Reporta comparativos em cinco acoes com metricas completas (CR/SR/MDD/volatilidade) e teste de significancia (Wilcoxon).
Ablations de Top-K (cognitive span) e perfis de risco mostram como arquitetura/memoria afetam performance.

Ha indicio de selecao de configuracao no periodo de teste (risco de overfitting/tuning no teste).

bibliographic.title: Alpha-GPT: Human-AI Interactive Alpha Mining for Quantitative Investment
bibliographic.authors: Wang, S.; Yuan, H.; Zhou, L.; Ni, L.M.; Shum, H.-Y.; Guo, J.

classification.decision_basis: Pipeline iterativo de ideation->implementation->review com agentes especializados e uso de backtesting/alpha search como ferramenta (loop de feedback para refinar alphas), mediando interacao humano-AI em mineracao de sinais.

architecture.model_stack: Sistema interativo de alpha mining com LLM como mediador: Trading Idea Polisher (NL->prompt), Knowledge Compiler (memoria + retrieval de exemplos), geracao de expressoes/implementacoes de alpha + configs, Alpha Search (inclui GP) e Backtest Engine; Analyst sintetiza retorno/IC/Sharpe e explicacoes (Thoughts Decompiler). Modelos LLM citados como opcoes (GPT/Claude/Bard) no diagrama.
architecture.environment: Alpha mining com backtests historicos e avaliacao iterativa; avaliado em competicao WorldQuant International Quant Championship 2024.

market_setting.universe: Acoes chinesas e dos EUA (intraday volume-price); avaliacao em plataforma WorldQuant IQC 2024 (formulaic alpha mining).
market_setting.horizon: Sinais/alphas para previsao de retornos futuros; horizonte especifico nao explicitado no trecho.
market_setting.sample_period: Exemplo: S&P500 (weekly) 2020-2023; IQC 2024 Stage 2 (resultados ate 2024-06-25).
market_setting.data_sources: Dados intraday volume-price (OHLCV, VWAP, setor) para acoes chinesas e US; WorldQuant IQC (operand fields + operadores; criterios de retorno/turnover/Sharpe).

evaluation.tier_justification: Evidencia forte de desempenho em mineracao de alphas: experimentos quantitativos (IC) e validacao em competicao real-time (WorldQuant IQC 2024), o que reduz risco de leakage; porem o texto extraido nao detalha friccoes de execucao/implementacao de trading (custos/slippage/impacto) e o ambiente do IQC e especifico a alphas.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabela 2 (IQC 2024 Stage 2, ate 2024-06-25): Alpha-GPT gerou 81 alphas qualificados; Total Score 48866; In-sample 65505; Out-of-sample 43319. Comparativos: Worldwide Top-1 (103 alphas; Total 52058; OOS 50111), Worldwide Top-10 (47; Total 47112; OOS 48715). Tabela 3 (consistencia ideia->formula): Human score 6.81 (win rate 13.40%) vs Alpha-GPT score 8.16 (win rate 86.60%). Tabela 4 (IC): Seed 0.58% -> Search Enhancement 1.23% -> Interaction+SE 2.23%.
evaluation.baselines: Comparacao com pesquisadores humanos (junior quants) para consistencia; leaderboard do WorldQuant IQC 2024; comparacoes internas (Seed vs SE vs Interaction+SE) por IC.
evaluation.ablations: Estagios do pipeline (Seed vs Search Enhancement vs Interaction+SE) avaliados por IC; estudos qualitativos de consistencia ideia->formula.
evaluation.robustness_tests: Avaliacao out-of-sample no IQC (score OOS) e curva de IC in-sample vs out-of-sample ao longo de iteracoes (estabilizacao apos ~15 iteracoes, descrito no texto).

realism.note: Usa backtests historicos e metricas financeiras; custos/slippage/impacto nao aparecem no texto extraido.

temporal_validity.note: Avaliacao no WorldQuant IQC 2024 foi conduzida em tempo real durante a competicao oficial, explicitando ausencia de leakage futuro; tambem reporta OOS score.

tuning_hygiene.note: Pipeline iterativo com review, mas sem protocolo formal de tuning/walk-forward no trecho extraido.

baseline_strength.note: Enquadra contra manual/GP; faltam comparacoes quantitativas detalhadas no trecho extraido.

statistical_validity.note: Sem ICs/replicacoes/formalismo estatistico visivel no texto extraido.

execution_feasibility.note: Foco em mineracao de sinais (nao execucao); viavel como etapa de pesquisa, mas execucao real nao modelada.

data_provenance.note: Cita competicao e uso de dados historicos; detalhes de provedores/universo nao aparecem no texto extraido.

ablation_completeness.note: Nao ha ablations detalhadas visiveis no texto extraido.

transparency.note: Descreve arquitetura/papeis e metricas do backtest engine; detalhes completos de configs/datasets nao aparecem no trecho extraido.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe um workflow agentico de alpha mining com humano-no-loop: o sistema traduz ideias em linguagem natural para expressoes formulaicas e implementacoes, executa avaliacao (IC/Sharpe/turnover via backtest/plataforma) e usa memoria/retrieval para consistencia e interpretabilidade. market_setting.data_sources: Dados de mercado para CSI300/CSI1000; executa backtesting com execucao no close e sinais por alphas; operadores/campos de dados para formulas (conjunto de campos e operadores).
market_setting.market_constraints: Custo de transacao conservador 0.15% por trade; limite de turnover via no maximo n acoes compradas/vendidas por dia (n=k/w com k=top10% e w=horizonte).

evaluation.tier_justification: Reporta mineracao de alphas e avaliacao em dados reais (CSI300/CSI1000) com split temporal claro (2011-2020 vs 2021-2024), metricas de previsao (IC/RankIC) e desempenho de estrategia (AR/IR), incluindo friccao (0.15% custo por trade) e controle de turnover; ainda e offline/backtest e sem microestrutura detalhada.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabelas (ex.: 9-13): IC, RankIC, AR (annual return) e IR para LightGBM/MLP, variando Alpha Num=10/50/100 em CSI300/CSI1000. Inclui analise de custo (server+API).
evaluation.baselines: GP, DSO, AlphaGen, AlphaForge, CoT, ToT, FAMA e comparacao sob equal API cost; modelos preditivos LightGBM/MLP.
evaluation.ablations: Analise de eficiencia sob equal API cost; comparacao por numero de alphas e por pools (CSI300 vs CSI1000).
evaluation.robustness_tests: Resultados em dois universos (CSI300 e CSI1000) e varios tamanhos de alpha sets; compara multiplas familias de baselines.

realism.note: Inclui custo de transacao (0.15% por trade) e limita turnover (n=k/w) no backtest/estrategia; ainda sem microestrutura/impacto.

temporal_validity.note: Split cronologico treino/teste explicitado (2011-2020 vs 2021-2024) e execucao no close para alvos 10/30 dias.

tuning_hygiene.note: Busca guiada por MCTS com evitacao de subtrees frequentes e avaliacao; protocolo formal de validacao pode nao estar completo no trecho.

baseline_strength.note: Compara contra GP/DSO/AlphaGen/AlphaForge e baselines LLM (CoT/ToT) e FAMA; reporta tabelas extensas.

statistical_validity.note: Reporta metricas agregadas (IC/RankIC/AR/IR) em diferentes tamanhos de alpha sets; nao ha ICs/replicacoes explicitas no trecho.

execution_feasibility.note: Pipeline de formula mining e estrategia preditiva e executavel; detalhes de ordem/fills nao aparecem.

data_provenance.note: Define universos (CSI300, CSI1000) e usa modelos (LightGBM/MLP); provedores e preprocessamento nao estao completos no trecho.

ablation_completeness.note: Inclui comparacao sob equal API cost e analises de eficiencia; ablations internos do MCTS nao estao detalhados no trecho.

transparency.note: Inclui prompts e mecanica (MCTS + backtesting feedback) e tabelas; detalhes completos de implementacao/dados podem faltar.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe um framework de mineracao de alphas formulaicos onde um LLM gera e refina expressoes simbolicas, enquanto um MCTS organiza a exploracao e usa feedback quantitativo (backtesting/simulacao) para guiar a busca. A combinacao de busca estruturada + geracao linguistica visa aumentar eficiencia, diversidade e interpretabilidade das formulas, com avaliacao empirica em universos reais (CSI300/CSI1000).
pontos_fortes: Evidencia empirica forte em pools reais (CSI300/CSI1000) com tabelas de IC/RankIC e AR/IR e muitos baselines.
Mecanismo de busca (MCTS) + diversidade (subtree avoidance) endereca ineficiencia/overfitting de buscas cegas.
pontos_fracos: Friccoes/custos e modelo de execucao nao aparecem no trecho extraido.
Detalhes completos de split temporal e controle de leakage nao estao totalmente visiveis no trecho extraido.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: LLM gera/refina formulas; MCTS escolhe exploracao; cada alpha recebe feedback de backtesting; melhores entram no Alpha Zoo e viram features para modelos (LightGBM/MLP).
2) Evidencia: Tier 2 (tabelas extensas em CSI300/CSI1000 com IC/RankIC e AR/IR; muitos baselines; mas sem friccoes).
3) Limitacao: sem custos/slippage/impacto e sem detalhes completos de split temporal no trecho extraido.
4) Taxonomia: agente auto-melhorante para descoberta de sinais (alpha mining) com tool-calling (execucao/backtest/retrieval).

bibliographic.title: PIXIU: A Large Language Model, Instruction Data and Evaluation Benchmark for Finance
bibliographic.authors: Xie, Q.; Han, W.; Zhang, X.; Lai, Y.; Peng, M.; Lopez-Lira, A.; Huang, J. (2023)

classification.decision_basis: Paper de FinLLM + instruction data + benchmark (FLARE); inclui tarefas financeiras (sentiment/QA/NER e stock movement prediction), mas nao descreve sistema de trading/execucao.

architecture.model_stack: Pixiu/FinMA: LLM financeiro + instruction tuning (ex.: FinMA-7B/30B; FinMA-7B-full com NLP+prediction datasets).
architecture.environment: Avaliacao em benchmark FLARE (zero-shot/few-shot) e datasets financeiros multimodais (texto, tabelas, series historicas).

market_setting.universe: Tarefas financeiras: sentiment (FPB, FiQA-SA), headline classification, NER (FIN dataset), QA (FinQA/ConvFinQA), e stock movement prediction (BigData22/ACL18/CIKM18).
market_setting.horizon: N/A
market_setting.sample_period: Variavel por dataset (ex.: Gold headline dataset 2000-2019 citado para headline classification).
market_setting.data_sources: Tabela 2 (raw/instruction): FPB; FiQA-SA; Headline; NER (financial agreements/FIN); FinQA/ConvFinQA (earnings reports com tabelas); BigData22/ACL18/CIKM18 (tweets + historical prices time-series).

evaluation.tier_justification: Avaliacao e em benchmarks de NLP/forecasting (inclui stock movement prediction), mas nao ha avaliacao de trading (PnL com custos/execucao) no texto extraido.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabela 5 (FLARE; zero/few-shot): FPB F1 ate 0.88 (FinMA-30B) vs 0.78 (GPT-4) e 0.51 (BloombergGPT). Headline AvgF1 ~0.97-0.98 (FinMA). FiQA-SA F1 ate 0.87 (FinMA-30B). ConvFinQA EmAcc 0.40 (FinMA-30B). FinQA EmAcc 0.11 (FinMA-30B). Stock movement: ACL18 Acc 0.56 (FinMA-7B-full) com MCC 0.10; BigData22 MCC ~0.04; CIKM18 Acc ~0.57 (GPT-4) vs 0.56 (FinMA-7B-full) (detalhes na Tabela 5).
evaluation.baselines: BLOOM/NeoX; OPT 66B; ChatGPT; GPT-4; BloombergGPT; (comparacoes por dataset no FLARE).
evaluation.ablations: Comparacao de FinMA (7B/30B/7B-full) e zero-shot vs few-shot por dataset (FLARE).

realism.note: Benchmark de NLP/predicao; sem backtest de trading/execucao.

temporal_validity.note: Inclui tarefa de predicao financeira, mas nao detalha controles de leakage/backtesting de mercado.

tuning_hygiene.note: Descreve fine-tuning/instruction tuning e variantes (full), mas sem protocolo de selecao walk-forward de trading.

baseline_strength.note: Compara com varios LLMs fortes (GPT-4/ChatGPT/BloombergGPT) e modelos open (BLOOM/OPT/NeoX/Vicuna).

statistical_validity.note: Reporta metricas padrao (F1/Acc/MCC/EmAcc), sem incerteza/ICs.

execution_feasibility.note: Nao discute execucao/ordens ou viabilidade operacional de trading.

data_provenance.note: Modelo/dados/benchmark sao abertos e com repo; descreve escala do instruction data (136K).

ablation_completeness.note: Analisa influencia de tamanho e do tuning com dados de predicao; sem ablations de trading.

transparency.note: Open-source + tabelas detalhadas de benchmark e discussao de limitacoes.

governance_integrity.market_integrity_risks: Menciona impactos negativos potenciais como desinformacao financeira e influencia de mercado anti-etica (limitacoes).

synthesis.contribuicao: Introduz o framework PIXIU como um pacote completo para avancar LLMs em fincas: um FinLLM open-source (FinMA) instruction-tuned, um grande dataset de instrucoes (FIT, ~136K), e um benchmark holistico (FLARE) cobrindo tarefas de NLP e uma tarefa de predicao financeira. A principal contribuicao e padronizar recursos e avaliacao para comparar modelos e acelerar pesquisa aberta.
pontos_fortes: Recursos abertos (modelo, dados, benchmark) com avaliacao ampla em multiplas tarefas financeiras.
Comparacao forte com baselines relevantes (GPT-4/ChatGPT/BloombergGPT) e analise de efeitos de tuning/dados.
pontos_fracos: Nao fornece avaliacao de estrategia de trading (Sharpe/CAGR/MDD) nem friccoes/execucao.
Desempenho em predicao de movimento (MCC) aparece baixo, sugerindo dificuldade do task e possivel limitacao do setup.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: FinMA (LLaMA fine-tuned) + instruction data FIT + benchmark FLARE para tarefas financeiras (sentiment/NER/QA/predicao).
2) Evidencia: Tier 0 para trading (e benchmark de tarefas, nao backtest).
3) Limitacao: nao fecha loop de mercado (portfolio/execucao) nem mede retorno ajustado a risco com custos.
4) Taxonomia: infraestrutura/benchmark de FinLLM que pode alimentar agentes, mas nao e um agente de trading.

bibliographic.title: Qlib: An AI-oriented Quantitative Investment Platform
bibliographic.authors: Yang, X.; Liu, W.; Zhou, D.; Bian, J.; Liu, T.-Y. (2020)

classification.decision_basis: Plataforma open-source para pesquisa quant (CDPE pipeline, storage/cache, backtesting como etapa do workflow); nao e um agente LLM/agentic.

architecture.model_stack: Qlib: plataforma de investimento quantitativo orientada a AI, com pipeline config-driven (CDPE), cache de expressoes/datasets, e componentes para data processing, model training e backtesting.
architecture.environment: Pipeline de pesquisa quant (load OHLCV, compute features/factors, filter universe, combine data) com avaliacao de performance de infra (Table 1) e exemplo de config-driven workflow.

market_setting.universe: Exemplos de pools (menciona SP500 como caso de filtragem diaria) e workflow geral de pesquisa quant.
market_setting.horizon: N/A (paper foca infraestrutura; backtesting como etapa do workflow)
market_setting.sample_period: 2007-01-01 a 2020-01-01 (na avaliacao de performance de infra; conforme descricao do use case)
market_setting.data_sources: Dados OHLCV diarios + pools dinamicos; plataforma open-source (repo Microsoft Qlib).

evaluation.tier_justification: O paper descreve plataforma e avalia performance de infraestrutura/pipeline; nao reporta resultados de trading (Sharpe/CAGR/MDD/PnL) de estrategias no trecho extraido.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabela 1: comparacao de performance (tempo total) entre HDF5/MySQL/MongoDB/InfluxDB e Qlib. Ex.: Total (1CPU) ~184s (HDF5) vs ~147s (Qlib -E -D) vs ~7.4s (Qlib +E +D com cache). Reporta medias +/- desvio.
evaluation.baselines: HDF5, MySQL, MongoDB, InfluxDB (storage/queries) vs configuracoes Qlib com/sem expression cache e dataset cache.

realism.note: Inclui simulador/Orders Executor e pipeline completo; mas sem avaliacao de PnL com friccoes no paper.

temporal_validity.note: Nao e um estudo de previsao/backtest; detalhes de controle de leakage nao sao foco.

tuning_hygiene.note: Sem protocolo de tuning de estrategia; foco e infraestrutura.

baseline_strength.note: Comparacao direta com solucoes de armazenamento populares no use case.

statistical_validity.note: Reporta tempos com media e variancia (ex.: +/-) para passos do pipeline.

execution_feasibility.note: Fornece componentes para execucao/simulacao e analise, mas sem detalhes microestruturais no paper.

data_provenance.note: Repo open-source (microsoft/qlib) e descricao clara do use case/dados (OHLCV, pool dinamico).

ablation_completeness.note: Nao ha ablations; comparacao e por alternativas de storage/cache.

transparency.note: Arquitetura modular descrita e codigo aberto citado; tabelas detalhadas de performance.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe o Qlib como uma plataforma open-source, modular e orientada a AI para pesquisa em investimento quantitativo, cobrindo desde ingestao/armazenamento e engenharia de fatores ate criacao de modelos, construcao de portfolio e simulacao/analise. A contribuicao central esta em padronizar e acelerar o workflow, com uma infraestrutura de dados (cache + expression engine) que melhora significativamente o desempenho.
pontos_fortes: Infraestrutura e workflow end-to-end (dados -> modelo -> portfolio -> simulacao) com modularidade e extensibilidade.
Benchmark de performance de armazenamento/processamento mostrando ganhos grandes com caches/engine.
pontos_fracos: Nao apresenta resultados de trading (retorno/Sharpe/drawdown) para validar impacto financeiro da plataforma.
Detalhes de realismo de execucao (slippage/impacto/latencia) nao sao explicitados no paper.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: plataforma Qlib para pesquisa quant, com modulos de dados, features, modelos, portfolio, simulador e analise.
2) Evidencia: Tier 0 para trading (avaliacao e de performance de infraestrutura, nao PnL).
3) Limitacao: sem metricas de retorno ajustado a risco e sem friccoes de execucao no benchmark.
4) Taxonomia: ferramenta/infra (backtesting + dados) que pode ser um 'tool' dentro de agentes de trading.

bibliographic.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
bibliographic.authors: Shinn, N.; Cassano, F.; Berman, E.; Gopinath, A.; Narasimhan, K.; Yao, S. (2023)

classification.decision_basis: Agente de linguagem com loop de auto-reflexao para melhorar desempenho em tasks (coding/QA); nao ha ligacao com trading.

architecture.model_stack: Reflexion: agentes de linguagem com verbal reinforcement learning via auto-reflexao e memoria episodica; aplicado a programacao (HumanEval/MBPP; Python/Rust) e QA (HotPotQA).
architecture.environment: Ambiente de avaliacao inclui execucao de unit tests (coding benchmarks) e QA multi-hop (HotPotQA); compara Base vs Reflexion e ablations (episodic memory; CoT/ReAct).

market_setting.universe: Nao aplicavel (tarefas gerais: AlfWorld, HotPotQA, HumanEval/MBPP/LeetcodeHardGym).
market_setting.data_sources: Benchmarks de agentes e programacao; codigo/demos/datasets citados em repo do projeto.

evaluation.tier_justification: Ha avaliacao empirica forte de agentes em benchmarks, mas nao ha validacao em trading/mercados.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabela 1: pass@1 HumanEval(PY)=91.0 (vs GPT-4 80.1); HumanEval(RS)=68.0; LeetcodeHard(PY)=15.0 (vs 7.5). Tabelas 2-5 trazem analise de testes internos e ganhos em HotPotQA/AlfWorld.
evaluation.baselines: CoT-only, ReAct-only, episodic memory (EPM) e modelos (text-davinci-003, gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4).
evaluation.ablations: Ablations de tipo de feedback, incorporacao de feedback, memoria episodica vs reflexao, e omissoes (sem test generation / sem self-reflection).

realism.note: Nao e paper de trading; avaliacao e em ambientes de agentes e coding.

temporal_validity.note: Sem consideracoes de temporalidade de mercado.

tuning_hygiene.note: Nao depende de fine-tuning; melhora via memoria/reflexao (in-context).

baseline_strength.note: Compara contra baselines fortes (ReAct/CoT) e modelos (GPT-4, etc.).

statistical_validity.note: Reporta resultados em varios benchmarks; detalhes de repeticoes/ICs nao sao o foco.

execution_feasibility.note: Nao discute execucao de ordens/mercado.

data_provenance.note: Repo publico com codigo/demos/datasets e benchmarks padrao.

ablation_completeness.note: Ablations extensos isolando memoria vs reflexao e fontes de feedback.

transparency.note: Descricao clara do loop e exemplos; tabelas detalhadas + release de codigo.

synthesis.contribuicao: Propõe o Reflexion como um mecanismo leve para agentes baseados em LLM aprenderem por tentativa e erro sem atualizacao de pesos: o agente transforma feedback em reflexoes verbais e guarda essas reflexoes em memoria episodica para orientar novas acoes. O trabalho e altamente relevante para sistemas agenticos (inclusive em fincas) como um bloco de arquitetura de auto-melhora e correcao iterativa.
pontos_fortes: Loop claro de feedback -> reflexao -> memoria -> melhora, com ganhos consistentes em multiplas tarefas.
Ablations e analises detalhadas isolando o papel da reflexao e do mecanismo de feedback.
pontos_fracos: Nao e validado em ambientes financeiros/trading; generalizacao para mercados e hipotetica.
Nao aborda controles de seguranca/governanca para tool use em dominios sensiveis (ex.: trading).
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: agente LLM que executa episodios, recebe feedback, escreve uma reflexao e persiste memoria para melhorar proximas tentativas.
2) Evidencia: Tier 0 para trading (benchmark de agentes/coding, nao mercado).
3) Limitacao: falta validacao em backtest/execucao e consideracoes de risco/seguranca em fincas.
4) Taxonomia: componente arquitetural para agentes (aprendizado por reflexao) que pode ser acoplado a agentes de trading.

bibliographic.title: BBT-Fin: Comprehensive Construction of Chinese Financial Domain Pre-trained Language Model, Corpus and Benchmark

classification.decision_basis: Modelo(s) PLM/LLM para NLP financeiro chines (BBT-Fin/FinT5) + benchmark CFLEB; nao e sistema de trading.

architecture.model_stack: BBT-FinT5 (base 220M; large ~1B) baseado em T5, pre-treinado em BBT-FinCorpus (~300GB) e com variante knowledge-enhanced (KETM) usando knowledge graph (CN-DBPedia). Benchmark BBT-CFLEB (FinCUGE) com 6 datasets (4 de entendimento + 2 de geracao).
architecture.environment: Avaliacao em benchmark BBT-CFLEB/FinCUGE com tarefas como classificacao de noticias, summarization, relation extraction, QA e negative news determination, reportando F1/ROUGE/medias.

market_setting.universe: Textos financeiros chineses (noticias/relatorios/social media) nas tarefas do benchmark BBT-CFLEB; nao ha universo de mercado para trading.
market_setting.data_sources: BBT-FinCorpus (~300GB, 4 fontes) + datasets FinCUGE/BBT-CFLEB. Repo: ssymmetry/BBT-FinCUGE-Applications.

evaluation.tier_justification: Avaliacao e em benchmarks de NLP financeiro (CFLEB), nao em trading/backtest.
evaluation.key_metrics: Tabela 4 (BBT-CFLEB): Avg=77.07 (BBT-FinT5-large), com ganhos vs T5-base (74.89) e GPT2-base (68.37); KETM melhora relacao/sumarizacao (ex.: Ge.Avg 68.51 vs 67.44).
evaluation.baselines: GPT2-base, T5-base, FinBERT-base, Mengzi-BERT-base-fin, FinT5-base; comparacao vs BBT-FinT5 (base/KE/large).
evaluation.ablations: Efeitos de (i) domain pre-training (FinCorpus), (ii) knowledge-enhanced text modeling (KETM), e (iii) escala de parametros (base vs large).

realism.note: Sem backtest/execucao; foco e NLP/benchmarks.

temporal_validity.note: Nao ha protocolo temporal de mercado; tarefas de NLP.

tuning_hygiene.note: Descreve pre-treino e fine-tuning por tarefa; higiene de tuning de trading nao se aplica.

baseline_strength.note: Comparacao multi-modelo (BERT/T5/GPT2 e variantes financeiras) no mesmo benchmark.

statistical_validity.note: Reporta metricas por task e medias; sem ICs/repeticoes.

execution_feasibility.note: Nao descreve execucao de trading.

data_provenance.note: Corpus e benchmark sao descritos e recursos/modelos sao liberados via repo.

ablation_completeness.note: Ablations por arquitetura (T5 vs GPT2), por dominio (T5-base vs FinT5) e por KETM/escala.

transparency.note: Tabela de resultados + descricao do corpus/benchmark e release de codigo/modelo.

synthesis.contribuicao: Construi um pacote abrangente para NLP financeiro em chines: um grande corpus aberto (~300GB), um PLM baseado em T5 (BBT-FinT5) e um benchmark (BBT-CFLEB/FinCUGE) com tarefas de entendimento e geracao. O trabalho e relevante para agentes/coplilots financeiros por melhorar a base linguistica e prover avaliacao padronizada.
pontos_fortes: Recursos abertos (corpus, modelo, benchmark) e avaliacao comparativa ampla.
Mostra ganhos consistentes de domain pre-training, KETM e scaling de parametros.
pontos_fracos: Nao avalia impacto em trading/backtests nem liga diretamente a PnL.
Falta quantificacao de incerteza/robustez estatistica alem das metricas agregadas.
synthesis.advisor_summary:
1) Sistema: PLM financeiro chines (T5) + corpus (300GB) + benchmark (BBT-CFLEB) para tarefas de NLP/geracao.
2) Evidencia: Tier 0 para trading (benchmarks de NLP).
3) Limitacao: nao conecta a execucao/portfolio/backtest; utilidade para trading e indireta.
4) Taxonomia: infraestrutura de linguagem (FinPLM) que pode alimentar agentes/analistas financeiros.

bibliographic.title: Temporal Data Meets LLM: Explainable Financial Time Series Forecasting
bibliographic.authors: Yu, X.; Chen, Z.; Ling, Y.; Dong, S.; Liu, Z.; Lu, Y. (2023)

classification.decision_basis: Uso de LLMs para forecasting explicavel de retornos (weekly/monthly) com prompts e CoT; avalia MSE e precisao binaria, mas nao e um sistema de trading agentic.

architecture.model_stack: Compara GPT-4 (zero/few-shot; com CoT) e OpenLLaMA-13B fine-tuned (com/sem CoT) contra baselines (ARMA-GARCH, GBDT/LightGBM, most-frequent historical).
architecture.environment: Forecasting de retornos semanais/mensais com prompts (company profile + historico + noticias); avaliacao por MSE e precisao binaria e qualidade de explicacao por ROUGE.
